banking-and-online-services-support.title: Banking and Online Services Support
banking-and-online-services-support.introduction: Atención de consultas sobre cuentas, tarjetas, transacciones y acceso a banca en línea. La prioridad es verificar la identidad, proteger la información y explicar los siguientes pasos con precisión.
banking-and-online-services-support.skills: Atención al detalle, confidencialidad, paciencia, comunicación clara y seguimiento de procesos.

vocabulary.example: Your available account balance is $420.
I need to verify the account holder first.
The available balance may exclude pending charges.
You can download your bank statement online.
Please confirm the billing address on file.
Your card was declined at the store.
I can explain the card replacement process.
Never share your login credentials.

The deposit is still being processed.
We can open a dispute for the charge.
A fraud alert was placed on the account.
I need to transfer this case to the fraud department.

interviewQuestions.question: Why are you interested in banking customer service?
interviewQuestions.demonstrates: Relacioná tu interés con precisión, servicio, confidencialidad y aprendizaje de procesos.

interviewQuestions.question: How would you assist a customer who reports an unauthorized charge?
interviewQuestions.demonstrates: Priorizá verificación, protección de la cuenta, documentación y escalamiento sin prometer reembolso.

interviewQuestions.question: How do you make sure you handle sensitive information correctly?
interviewQuestions.demonstrates: Justificá atención al detalle y respeto por procedimientos con un ejemplo real.

interviewQuestions.question: Tell me about a time you noticed an important detail others missed.
interviewQuestions.demonstrates: Podés usar estudios, documentos, pagos o proyectos; explicá cómo verificaste y actuaste.

rolePlays.label: Fácil
rolePlays.title: ACCESO BLOQUEADO
rolePlays.situation: El cliente olvidó su contraseña y no puede entrar a la banca en línea.
rolePlays.agentObjective: Verify identity; identify the login error; guide the password reset; confirm access.
dialogue: Customer: I forgot my password and I cannot access my account.
Agent: I can help you with the reset. Before we continue, I need to verify your identity.
Customer: Sure.
Agent: Thank you. I will send a one-time code to the phone number on file. Please let me know when you receive it.
Customer: I received it.
Agent: Great. Enter the code and create a new password. Were you able to sign in?
Customer: Yes, I am in now.
Agent: Perfect. Is there anything else I can help you with today?

rolePlays.label: Intermedio
rolePlays.title: TARJETA RECHAZADA
rolePlays.situation: La tarjeta fue rechazada durante una compra y el cliente necesita entender por qué.
rolePlays.agentObjective: Verify; check card status and available balance; explain without blaming; offer the authorized next step.
dialogue: Customer: My debit card was declined, but I have money in my account.
Agent: I understand how inconvenient that is. Let me review the card status and recent activity.
Customer: Okay.
Agent: The card is active, but the purchase triggered a security review. Do you recognize the attempted transaction at Green Market?
Customer: Yes, that was me.
Agent: Thank you for confirming. I can mark it as recognized. Please wait a few minutes before trying again.
Customer: Will it definitely work?
Agent: I cannot guarantee the approval, but the security restriction has been reviewed and you may try again.

rolePlays.label: Difícil
rolePlays.title: CARGO NO RECONOCIDO
rolePlays.situation: El cliente ve un cargo que no reconoce y exige que el dinero sea devuelto inmediatamente.
rolePlays.agentObjective: Protect the account; document the charge; avoid promising reimbursement; explain dispute and escalation.
dialogue: Customer: Someone used my card. I want my money back right now.
Agent: I am sorry this happened. I will help you protect the account and report the charge. First, do you still have the card with you?
Customer: Yes.
Agent: Thank you. I recommend freezing it now. I also need to confirm which transaction you do not recognize.
Customer: The $185 charge from yesterday.
Agent: I have documented it and will open a dispute. The investigation team will review the transaction and contact you with the outcome.
Customer: So you will refund it today?
Agent: I cannot guarantee an immediate refund, but I can make sure the report is submitted correctly and give you the case number.

banking-and-online-services-support.selfAssessment: ¿Utilicé vocabulario relevante? ¿Hice preguntas antes de asumir? ¿Expliqué el siguiente paso? ¿Evité prometer algo que no puedo garantizar? ¿Mi inglés fue claro y coherente?

hotel-guest-relocation-support.title: Hotel Guest Relocation Support
hotel-guest-relocation-support.introduction: Asistencia a huéspedes cuando una propiedad no puede respetar una reservación. El agente confirma la situación, busca alojamiento alternativo y coordina con hoteles sin prometer beneficios no autorizados.
hotel-guest-relocation-support.skills: Empatía, organización, rapidez para investigar, comunicación entre varias partes y manejo de presión.

vocabulary.example: We are looking for alternative accommodation.
There should be no additional charge without confirmation.
I found an alternative property nearby.
I need to confirm room availability.
Please provide the booking confirmation.
What is your booking reference?
The hotel reported a cancellation.
What time is your check-in?
Your check-out date remains the same.

Write down the new confirmation number.

Please confirm your travel dates.

Let me confirm the booking details first.

interviewQuestions.question: Why are you interested in travel customer support?
interviewQuestions.demonstrates: Conectá comunicación, empatía y capacidad de coordinar soluciones bajo presión.

interviewQuestions.question: How would you help a guest whose hotel cannot honor the reservation?
interviewQuestions.demonstrates: Explicá cómo confirmarías datos, necesidades y disponibilidad antes de mover al huésped.

interviewQuestions.question: How do you communicate when a solution takes time?
interviewQuestions.demonstrates: Demostrá seguimiento, actualizaciones y expectativas realistas.

interviewQuestions.question: Tell me about a time you had to organize several details quickly.
interviewQuestions.demonstrates: Usá una experiencia real y explicá cómo priorizaste sin perder información.

rolePlays.label: Fácil
rolePlays.title: RESERVACIÓN NO LOCALIZADA
rolePlays.situation: El hotel no encuentra la reservación del huésped.
rolePlays.agentObjective: Collect booking details; contact property; confirm status; explain next step.
dialogue: Customer: The hotel says they cannot find my reservation.
Agent: I am sorry about the confusion. May I have your booking reference and the name on the reservation?
Customer: It is RZ2048 under Maria Lopez.
Agent: Thank you. I found the booking in our system. I will contact the property to confirm it.
Customer: Should I wait in the lobby?
Agent: Yes, please. I will update you as soon as the hotel responds.
Customer: Okay.
Agent: Thank you for your patience. I am still working on your case.

rolePlays.label: Intermedio
rolePlays.title: HOTEL LLENO
rolePlays.situation: La propiedad confirma que está llena y no puede recibir al huésped.
rolePlays.agentObjective: Acknowledge; ask needs; search comparable room; confirm before directing guest.
dialogue: Customer: They told me the hotel is full even though I paid.
Agent: I understand how frustrating that is. I will help you look for another property. How many guests are traveling?
Customer: Two adults.
Agent: Do you need the same room type or any special accommodation?
Customer: We need one queen bed.
Agent: I found a comparable hotel eight minutes away. I am calling to confirm the room before asking you to travel there.
Customer: Will I pay more?
Agent: I am checking the rate difference and will explain any authorized option before confirming.

rolePlays.label: Difícil
rolePlays.title: FAMILIA VARADA
rolePlays.situation: Una familia llega de noche; el hotel está lleno y las primeras alternativas están lejos.
rolePlays.agentObjective: De-escalate; identify children/accessibility; search safely; communicate updates; avoid unapproved promises.
dialogue: Customer: We have two children and nowhere to sleep. This is unacceptable.
Agent: I am very sorry. I understand that finding a safe room tonight is the priority. Let me confirm the number of guests and any special needs.
Customer: Two adults and two children. We need two beds.
Agent: Thank you. The closest property is full, so I am expanding the search while keeping the same room requirement.
Customer: Are you paying for transportation?
Agent: I need to review the relocation policy before confirming transportation. I will not ask you to move until the room is secured.
Customer: How long will this take?
Agent: I am contacting two properties now and will update you as soon as each one responds.

hotel-guest-relocation-support.selfAssessment: ¿Utilicé vocabulario relevante? ¿Hice preguntas antes de asumir? ¿Expliqué el siguiente paso? ¿Evité prometer algo que no puedo garantizar? ¿Mi inglés fue claro y coherente?

medical-authorization-support.title: Medical Authorization Support
medical-authorization-support.introduction: Procesamiento y seguimiento de autorizaciones médicas o de medicamentos. El agente verifica información, explica estados y solicita documentación, pero no diagnostica ni decide tratamientos.
medical-authorization-support.skills: Precisión, confidencialidad, atención al detalle, organización y comunicación profesional.

vocabulary.example: Additional information is required before review.
The request is pending approval.
Please write down the authorization number.
We received the authorization request yesterday.

Please confirm the date of service.

interviewQuestions.question: Why are you interested in medical authorization support?
interviewQuestions.demonstrates: Relacioná precisión, servicio y disposición para aprender procesos de seguros de salud.

interviewQuestions.question: What would you do if a member asks you to approve a medication?
interviewQuestions.demonstrates: Marcá los límites del rol y explicá cómo revisarías el estado o proceso sin decidir clínicamente.

interviewQuestions.question: How do you avoid mistakes when reviewing documents?
interviewQuestions.demonstrates: Justificá tus hábitos de revisión, notas, listas o confirmación de datos.

interviewQuestions.question: How would you respond to an urgent and emotional caller?
interviewQuestions.demonstrates: Demostrá empatía, control, verificación y seguimiento del procedimiento urgente.

rolePlays.label: Fácil
rolePlays.title: ESTADO DE AUTORIZACIÓN
rolePlays.situation: Una farmacia llama para verificar si la autorización de un medicamento fue recibida.
rolePlays.agentObjective: Verify member and medication; locate request; state status; provide reference.
dialogue: Caller: I am calling from a pharmacy to check a prior authorization.
Agent: I can check the status. May I have the member ID and the name of the medication?
Caller: The member ID is M45821 and the medication is Med-X.
Agent: Thank you. The request was received this morning and is pending review.
Caller: Do you know when it will be approved?
Agent: I cannot guarantee the decision or exact completion time, but I can provide the reference number and current status.
Caller: Yes, please.
Agent: The reference number is PA-7304.

rolePlays.label: Intermedio
rolePlays.title: DOCUMENTACIÓN FALTANTE
rolePlays.situation: La autorización está detenida porque el proveedor no envió las notas clínicas.
rolePlays.agentObjective: Explain missing item; avoid blaming; tell approved submission process; document contact.
dialogue: Member: Why is my medication still not approved?
Agent: I understand the delay is concerning. I reviewed the request and it is waiting for additional clinical notes from the provider.
Member: Can I send them myself?
Agent: The documentation must come from the provider through the approved channel. I can give you the reference number to share with the office.
Member: Does that mean it will be approved after they send it?
Agent: The information will allow the review to continue, but I cannot guarantee the final decision.
Member: Please give me the number.
Agent: Certainly. It is PA-8491, and I will document our conversation.

rolePlays.label: Difícil
rolePlays.title: SOLICITUD URGENTE
rolePlays.situation: El miembro afirma que necesita el medicamento hoy y exige que el agente lo apruebe.
rolePlays.agentObjective: Show empathy; verify status; explain role limits; follow urgent procedure; avoid medical advice.
dialogue: Member: I need this medication today. Approve it now.
Agent: I am sorry you are dealing with this. I will check the status and see whether the urgent review process applies.
Member: My doctor already said I need it.
Agent: I understand. The clinical reviewer makes the authorization decision; I cannot approve medication myself. May I confirm the member ID and provider name?
Member: Yes, it is M77820 and Dr. Adams.
Agent: Thank you. The provider marked the request as urgent, and it is in expedited review.
Member: What should I take while I wait?
Agent: I cannot recommend treatment. Please contact your provider for medical guidance while the review is pending.

medical-authorization-support.selfAssessment: ¿Utilicé vocabulario relevante? ¿Hice preguntas antes de asumir? ¿Expliqué el siguiente paso? ¿Evité prometer algo que no puedo garantizar? ¿Mi inglés fue claro y coherente?

medical-and-dental-chat-support.title: Medical and Dental Chat Support
medical-and-dental-chat-support.introduction: Atención escrita sobre elegibilidad, cobertura, beneficios, redes de proveedores y estado de reclamos. Se evalúan redacción, precisión, empatía y capacidad para mantener informado al miembro.
medical-and-dental-chat-support.skills: Comunicación escrita, gramática, atención al detalle, empatía, typing y explicación de términos.

interviewQuestions.question: Why are you interested in written health insurance support?
interviewQuestions.demonstrates: Relacioná redacción, inglés, precisión y capacidad para explicar información.

interviewQuestions.question: How would you explain a deductible to a confused member?
interviewQuestions.demonstrates: Usá lenguaje sencillo sin cambiar la política ni garantizar costos.

interviewQuestions.question: How do you maintain quality while handling more than one chat?
interviewQuestions.demonstrates: Explicá organización, lectura completa, revisión antes de enviar y actualizaciones.

interviewQuestions.question: Tell me about a time you explained something complicated in a simple way.
interviewQuestions.demonstrates: Podés usar estudios, tecnología o un trámite; describí el resultado.

rolePlays.label: Fácil
rolePlays.title: LIMPIEZA DENTAL
rolePlays.situation: El miembro pregunta por chat si una limpieza dental está cubierta.
rolePlays.agentObjective: Verify; check dental benefit; explain frequency/conditions; avoid guaranteeing provider charge.
dialogue: Member: Is a dental cleaning covered?
Agent: I will be happy to check. May I have your member ID and date of birth?
Member: M10294, May 8, 1998.
Agent: Thank you. Your plan includes preventive dental cleanings twice per benefit year when you use an in-network provider.
Member: So it will be completely free?
Agent: The plan shows no copayment for the covered cleaning, but the final amount depends on the service billed and claim processing.
Member: Okay.
Agent: Would you like help checking whether your dentist is in network?

rolePlays.label: Intermedio
rolePlays.title: FACTURA INESPERADA
rolePlays.situation: El miembro recibió una factura y no entiende el EOB.
rolePlays.agentObjective: Separate bill from EOB; check claim; explain deductible/coinsurance in plain language.
dialogue: Member: I received a $240 bill. I thought I had insurance.
Agent: I understand why that is confusing. Let me review the claim and explanation of benefits.
Member: The visit was last month.
Agent: Thank you. The claim was processed, and part of the amount was applied to your deductible.
Member: What does that mean?
Agent: The deductible is the amount you pay for certain services before the plan begins sharing the cost. The EOB is not a bill, but it explains the allowed amount and your responsibility.
Member: Should I pay the provider?
Agent: Please compare the provider bill with the member responsibility shown on the EOB. I can help review both amounts.

rolePlays.label: Difícil
rolePlays.title: RECLAMO DENEGADO
rolePlays.situation: El miembro está molesto porque un procedimiento dental aparece como no cubierto.
rolePlays.agentObjective: Acknowledge; review code/status; explain available reason; provide appeal/review path without changing decision.
dialogue: Member: You denied my dental procedure. This is unfair.
Agent: I am sorry this has been frustrating. I will review the claim status and the reason listed.
Member: I already paid for insurance.
Agent: I understand. The claim shows the procedure was processed as a non-covered service under the current plan.
Member: Then change it.
Agent: I cannot change the claim decision in chat, but I can explain the review or appeal process and confirm which documents are needed.
Member: What do I need?
Agent: The notice requests the procedure details and supporting information from the dental provider. I can provide the submission instructions and claim number.

home-and-auto-claims-intake.title: Home and Auto Claims Intake
home-and-auto-claims-intake.introduction: Recepción y documentación inicial de accidentes, daños de vivienda y otras pérdidas aseguradas. El agente recopila hechos y explica el proceso; no determina responsabilidad ni garantiza cobertura.
home-and-auto-claims-intake.skills: Escucha activa, precisión, empatía, preguntas de seguimiento y documentación objetiva.

interviewQuestions.demonstrates: Relacioná escucha, documentación, empatía y trabajo con procesos.

interviewQuestions.question: What information would you collect after a vehicle accident?
interviewQuestions.demonstrates: Mencioná seguridad, lesiones, fecha, lugar, involucrados, daños y evidencia.

interviewQuestions.question: How would you respond if a customer demands confirmation of coverage?
interviewQuestions.demonstrates: Explicá que documentarías y aclararías el proceso sin garantizar una decisión.

interviewQuestions.question: Tell me about a time you stayed calm during an unexpected problem.
interviewQuestions.demonstrates: Justificá la fortaleza con acciones y aprendizaje, no solo con una palabra.

rolePlays.label: Fácil
rolePlays.title: VEHÍCULO ESTACIONADO
rolePlays.situation: El cliente reporta que encontró un golpe en su vehículo estacionado.
rolePlays.agentObjective: Check safety; collect time/location/damage; ask evidence; create claim.
dialogue: Customer: I found a large dent on my car in the parking lot.
Agent: I am sorry to hear that. Are you in a safe location now?
Customer: Yes.
Agent: When and where did you notice the damage?
Customer: This morning outside my apartment.
Agent: Do you have photos or information about another vehicle?
Customer: I have photos, but no information.
Agent: Thank you. I will document the damage and open the claim. An adjuster will review the next steps.

rolePlays.label: Intermedio
rolePlays.title: DAÑO POR TORMENTA
rolePlays.situation: Una tormenta dañó el techo y dos ventanas de la vivienda.
rolePlays.agentObjective: Verify safety; document cause/time/areas; advise evidence; explain adjuster follow-up without confirming coverage.
dialogue: Customer: A storm damaged my roof and two windows last night.
Agent: I am sorry this happened. Is everyone safe, and is the home currently habitable?
Customer: Yes, but water is entering one room.
Agent: Thank you. Please describe the damaged areas and any emergency steps already taken.
Customer: We covered the window and called a contractor.
Agent: Please keep photos and receipts for the claim review. I will document the loss and assign a claim number.
Customer: Is the roof definitely covered?
Agent: Coverage will be reviewed according to the policy and damage assessment. I cannot guarantee it during intake.

rolePlays.label: Difícil
rolePlays.title: ACCIDENTE CON LESIONES
rolePlays.situation: El cliente reporta un choque con otro vehículo y una posible lesión.
rolePlays.agentObjective: Prioritize safety/emergency services; collect facts objectively; avoid fault determination; escalate appropriately.
dialogue: Customer: Another driver hit me, and my passenger says her neck hurts.
Agent: I am sorry. Are you in a safe location, and have emergency services been contacted?
Customer: We are on the side of the road. The police are coming.
Agent: Please prioritize medical assistance. I can begin the report while you wait if it is safe to continue.
Customer: The other driver caused everything.
Agent: I will document your description, but I cannot determine fault during this call. What time and location did the collision occur?
Customer: At 6:20 p.m. on Pine Avenue.
Agent: Thank you. I will record that and note the reported injury for urgent follow-up.

smart-wellness-device-support.title: Smart Wellness Device Support
smart-wellness-device-support.introduction: Soporte para configuración, conectividad, sincronización y fallas de dispositivos de bienestar. El agente soluciona el equipo, pero no interpreta resultados ni ofrece consejo médico.

Agent: Our platform can provide an online listing and help potential guests find available rooms. The onboarding team also guides the setup.
Manager: What do you need to register?
Agent: Basic property information, photos, banking details and the required business documents. Would you like me to send the checklist and schedule onboarding?
Manager: Yes.
Agent: Great. I will send the summary and confirm a follow-up time.

rolePlays.title: PREOCUPACIÓN POR COMISIÓN
rolePlays.situation: El hotel está interesado, pero considera alta la comisión.
rolePlays.agentObjective: Acknowledge; understand current costs; explain value/terms transparently; offer review.
dialogue: Manager: Your commission sounds high.
Agent: I understand that commission directly affects your margins. May I ask how you currently attract online bookings?
Manager: We pay for ads and use another platform.
Agent: Thank you. Our service includes guest reach, listing tools and onboarding support. I can explain the exact commission and payment terms so you can compare the complete cost.
Manager: I do not want hidden fees.
Agent: Absolutely. We will review the service agreement and all applicable charges before activation. Would you like a written summary and a follow-up call?
Manager: Send the summary first.
Agent: I will send it today and contact you after you review it.

rolePlays.title: VARIAS PLATAFORMAS
rolePlays.situation: El hotel teme sobreventas y no quiere reemplazar sus canales actuales.
rolePlays.agentObjective: Explore operations; explain inventory options without unsupported claims; propose specialist follow-up.
dialogue: Manager: We already use two platforms. Adding another one will create overbookings.
Agent: That is a valid concern. How do you currently update room availability across channels?
Manager: Our staff updates each calendar manually.

Agent: I understand. Our onboarding specialist can review the available inventory options and determine how the platform would fit your process. I do not want to promise synchronization before checking compatibility.
Manager: I also will not remove my existing platforms.
Agent: You do not need to agree to replace them during this conversation. The next step can be a technical onboarding review focused on availability management.
Manager: Only if it is brief.
Agent: I can schedule a twenty-minute session and send the questions in advance.
